title: Mine-JEPA: In-Domain Self-Supervised Learning for Mine-Like Object Classification in Side-Scan Sonar
mechanism: In-domain SIGReg SSL on 1,170 unlabelled sonar images beats fine-tuned DINOv3; in-domain SSL applied on top of a foundation model degrades it.
adaptation: Evidence for training LeJEPA/FCMAE in-domain from scratch rather than continuing SSL on DINOv3; benchmark must report from-scratch in-domain and continued SSL as separate rows.
min_experiment: No standalone arm; covered by the LeJEPA experiment.
evidence: R: F1 0.935 vs DINOv3 0.922 (binary), 0.820 vs 0.810 (3-class); continued SSL on FMs -10 to -13 points.
